svg.title: Busy interval union and fragmented daily budgets

cc:Work.dc:title: Busy interval union and fragmented daily budgets
cc:Work.dc:description: Overlapping busy intervals are unioned and buffered before subtraction. Two 30-minute gaps yield only 30 usable minutes with a 50-minute budget and a 30-minute minimum session, or 60 with a 60-minute budget.
